entities.name: Kim Chang-Hee
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kim Chang-hee was a weightlifter from South Korea. He competed at the 1948, 1952 and 1956 Summer Olympics in the lightweight category and finished in sixth, fourth and third place, respectively. He won this event at the 1954 Asian Games.
